title: Add immature-yt , scriptsnsenses-sys , Davizigjojo , lolyeon2011-oss to the list
author: gggff123

gist.headline: Four Names Join the Garden
gist.blurb: The GitHub guest list grew by four. immature-yt, scriptsnsenses-sys, Davizigjojo, and lolyeon2011-oss now have their names in the hive ledger.
gist.summary: Added the GitHub IDs immature-yt, scriptsnsenses-sys, Davizigjojo, and lolyeon2011-oss to the shared authentication allowlist.
gist.impact: These four community members can now be recognized by the shared GitHub authentication flow.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy garden gate represents the shared GitHub authentication list, with four fresh name tags being added. Polli, wearing a tiny librarian hat, carefully pins the tags to a vine-covered welcome board while small code-flowers bloom nearby.
gist.image_prompt: A cozy pixel art scene of Polli, the cute yellow bee mascot with dark brown stripes, black antennae, pink rectangular cheek blushes, a happy smile, and rounded light-blue wings, wearing a tiny librarian hat as she pins four little name tags onto a vine-covered garden welcome board beside a glowing retro terminal. Lime green (#ecf874) is prominent among warm cream, mint, lavender, and peach flowers and code-plants; cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, nostalgic but beautiful.
